StreamFilter.description: Alias for  {@link  StreamFilterCriteria } , matching the `filterStreams` API.

activeOnly.description: When true, only include streams that are `"Active"` and not yet expired.

startTimeFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound (Unix seconds) on the stream's `startTime`.

startTimeTo.description: Inclusive upper bound (Unix seconds) on the stream's `startTime`.

endTimeFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound (Unix seconds) on the stream's `endTime`.

endTimeTo.description: Inclusive upper bound (Unix seconds) on the stream's `endTime`.
